note: Re-judged 2026-11-03 by an independent auditor who authored none of the change, after 2eebb4ac72. RFC 8654 Section 5: "A BGP speaker that has the ability to use BGP Extended Messages but has not advertised the BGP Extended Message Capability, presumably due to configuration, MUST NOT accept a BGP Extended Message." STALE because negotiateWith now computes the peer AS through s.judgedPeerAS(s.peerOpen), which calls the same sessionPeerAS(s.settings.PeerAS, !s.settings.DisableASN4, open) as before, plus comment edits. No message-length state moved: s.extendedMessage = s.negotiated.ExtendedMessageRecv and the writeBuf resize are unchanged, and capability.Negotiate is unchanged. TestRFC8654ReceiveLimitFollowsLocalOPEN drives a real OPEN exchange across local/peer advertisement, single and coalesced readers, and lengths 4096, 4097 and 65535, asserting acceptance only when the local side advertised (or length is 4096) and otherwise a Message Header Error / Bad Message Length NOTIFICATION carrying the erroneous Length with nothing dispatched; TestValidateLengthWithMax pins the header limit and the FRR interop checks cover both unadvertised directions. Verdict unchanged: enforced.
